title: The Lord's Promise of Restoration and the Righteous Branch
description: While Jeremiah is imprisoned in the guard court, the word of the Lord comes to him with promises that Jerusalem will be healed, the people's sins forgiven, and the land rebuilt. Central is the promise of a righteous Branch from David's line who will do what is right and just, and the city will be called 'The Lord Our Righteousness.' The Lord confirms with His covenant concerning day and night that the covenant with David and the Levitical priests will never be broken.
